}

# Dans le preambule
num <- function(x,round_precision =  NULL)
{
	if (is.null(round_precision)) {
		return(sprintf("\\num{%s}", x))
	} else {
		return(sprintf("\\num[round-precision=%s]{%s}",round_precision+1, x))
	}
}

# extract a simple table joining dams and segments, it exists in dam_rn_dwn which is the table of all dams downstream from a riversegment

# the path to the sea is the same as the idsegmentsource.

# I have to reproduce what is done in the method to get the size structures
# the steps are to get the matrix of size for the calculations done in tableturbine so it is an inner join
# it is done outside the class method


hpp_turb <- left_join(turb_rios@tablehppdbeel, turb_rios@tableturbinedbeel, by=c("hpp_id"="turb_hpp_id")) #1073
#hpp_turb[is.na(hpp_turb$idsegmentsource),]
# only one dam not projected

# Running turbine mortality function  ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

# see ticket #144 #150 recalculate proper middle class, the mean of a class is not in the middle #c(375,525,675,825)
# so the average values have been calculated in the next chunk (size structure). The values corresponding to mixed male and females are
# 0.285,0.363,0.523,0.666,0.840


turb_rios <- turbine_mortality (	turb_rios,					
		size_table_eel= hpp_turb[,c("cnsilver150300","cnsilver300450","cnsilver450600","cnsilver600750","cnsilver750")]/
				rowSums(hpp_turb[,c("cnsilver150300","cnsilver300450","cnsilver450600","cnsilver600750","cnsilver750")]),
		middle_class_eel = c(0.285,0.363,0.523,0.666,0.840)
)
